summary: Tested new SALES OVERVIEW card + Discount Codes admin tab (backend + frontend). 14/14 pytest tests passed. UI flows verified: admin login, Sales Overview time/ticket/metric filters, revenue equality with stat-revenue (9 629 Kč), VIP empty state, discount CRUD (create / edit / toggle / delete), duplicate code 409 toast, mobile 390px layout.

issues: Recharts logs 'width(-1) and height(-1)' warning during tab-switch/viewport-resize before ResponsiveContainer has laid out (chart still renders correctly). Purely a console noise, not user-visible.

critical_code_review_comments: SalesOverview.js does all filtering client-side from a single /admin/sales-overview fetch on mount — this is fine now but if paid orders scale into the tens of thousands the response (~capped at 100000) could get heavy. Consider a server-side aggregation endpoint later.

OverviewTab Category Card shows Standard SOLD=1 while stat-tickets-sold=22 and Sales Overview Standard=21 in preview DB — this is EXISTING behaviour outside this task's scope, but worth confirming with the main agent that categories.standard.sold semantics are intentional (e.g. excluding upgrades and comps in a different way). Not a regression from this iteration.
